reviews.title: Keeps disabling Apple Health integration for the scale
reviews.text:
I use Wyze scale almost daily and once in a few weeks I open Wyze with the goal to sync the data to Apple HealthKit. But often, Wyze app asks me to sign in again, I do that, to to Wyze Scale, it automatically syncs the data to Wyze, but not the HealthKit. Then I go to scale’s settings and find that syncing to HealthKit is disabled, AGAIN. And at this point it would sync my earlier data to HealthKit. Super annoying! 

Wyze, please get your stuff together!
1. Once I enabled data sync on this device, keep this setting on! If needed, store it in CloudKit or in UserDefaults and don’t clear it out next time you require me to re-logging and I login with the same account. 
2. Please add an option to put into HealthKit my data that was previously collected by Wyze and that you show me in the app. You have my data, now please put it all into HealthKit.
Thank you.

reviews.text:
response repeated updates to the app. I'll have to do it with billing from the developer to the customer. By the way if you didn't broke, don't fix it. Do sub categories of the app for users that do not use the new products. Do you understand oh, and I'm gonna add this to my second when you hit the developer, it takes you to the Y site and there's nothing there to contact the developer there just so you know, engineers i originally assumed that if I ever got a response to my app store review, it would actually come from Wyze itself, rather than automated developer scripts. But now it's clear why the app keeps changing: when you have an app that already works, it stops generating new revenue, so companies keep tinkering with it just to justify changes.
Starting with the current device menu layout—which is the first thing on my list of issues—the previous menu was just fine and a hell of a lot clearer than what we’re stuck with now. Take the hubs, for instance: you've got a sensor hub and the original hub, yet they aren't even grouped together in a proper hub section. Is it really just because someone didn't feel like writing a couple more sub-menus? Or because adding a search function for a specific version or type of camera—which would make actual, logical sense—was too much work? But hey, what do I know, I'm just the user, not the engineer.

For example, we have a motion sensing light over our driveway. Consistently, Wyze picks up the recording 10+ seconds after the event trigger. The recording shows the light already on, and whatever or whoever crossed the driveway are already out of view. What’s the point, Wyze? 
Also, two new cameras I just bought randomly lose network connection or seemingly die. The next day, they’re inexplicably back online and powered. How far Wyze has fallen. Go with another company. 

I used to love Wyze. Update after update the app gets more buggy and clumsy. 
STOP ASKING FOR MICROPHONE ACCESS. Just stop. I answered once- that should suffice. I shouldn’t be prompted every day multiple times. 

Also, stick to your wheelhouse and stop creating all the new gadgets. It’s becoming hokey at this point. Just stay in your lane and focus on what you’re good at.

I live upstairs and our downstairs neighbor has a dog who barks at everyone, and that’s when I’ll pick up my phone and see people walking by or sitting on the stairs in the video, but still no notification from this app.  It only let me know about vehicles driving by with Motion Completed.

UPDATE:  because how does this camera pick up the leaves blowing but it didn’t get the person putting something large in front of our stairs last night?  Thankful for the free month trial currently because I might be switching to Ring.

DAY 3: recorded video of someone screaming out front, heard the audio on the app.  The recording was silent.  Very upset because I need proof of these things!  Plus they keep spamming marketing notifications and emails after I turned them off.   Spend a little more on something else because not only do I currently feel unsafe, I am also annoyed!

A WEEK LATER: someone who’s been harassing us literally damaged property (again).  The camera picked up NOTHING, it won’t pick up people, but it sure lets me know when a car drives by every five minutes!!  Don’t recommend at all and will be upgrading.

reviews.title: Continuing to go downhill
reviews.text:
I’ve used Wyze products for years - since their very first camera. Their hardware remains fine. For the up-front price their hardware quality is great. Unfortunately selling quality products at a low price is apparently not a sustainable business model, and their attempts to bump profits are making the experience worse and worse. Their software is bloated, slow, ad-filled, and unreliable. The subscription model makes the actual price for a vaguely usable product suddenly no longer cheap or even competitive. Their AI is ludicrously, embarrassingly bad; stop calling my wife “a dog” please. The AI in particular makes using the app an unpleasant, annoying experience, unless you enjoy the puzzle of figuring out what something really is (is an “environmental trigger” a car? A dog? A marching band?). 

As an example of their incompetence, their “explain why this AI identification” form doesn’t work; you can fill it out, but there’s no “submit” option. It just sits there and disappears when you eventually have to close it. 

I’ve canceled my subscription and use the subscription price to buy several HomeKit-integrated cameras that do the same thing as Wyze without inundating me with ads, charging a subscription for basic use, or insulting my wife on a daily basis.

reviews.title: DON'T BUY V4 PAN — WYZE BROKE BASIC VIDEO QUALITY SETTINGS
reviews.text:
This is honestly baffling. The standard V4 has this functionality, but the V4 Pan , the supposedly "upgraded" model doesn't. How does a lower-priced camera outperform its own premium version?

There are only two quality options, with an enormous, unusable gap between them: 360p and 4K. Nothing in between — no 480p, 720p, or 1080p. Worse, the 360p setting doesn't even stick, it keeps reverting to Auto no matter how many times I manually set it. I never had this issue with the V4 alone, so this is clearly a V4 Pan-specific failure.

I am giving this 1 star for now. The product is of no use to me if it defaults to 4K and won't stay on 360p, all my recordings end up in Auto, which is mostly 4K, and it lags badly. If this is fixed, I'll happily raise my rating.

Save your money. Buy the regular V4 for $40 instead of paying double for the Pan and getting fewer working features in return. Thanks.

reviews.title: Record to SD card
reviews.text:
I used to be able to record to my SD card but stopped using the camera for a while and now after setting it up again I can’t see any recordings on my SD card. I got a new one to try it and same thing. So it’s not the SD card. The cards work fine everywhere else. The camera can see the card but keeps saying there’s nothing to view when I try look at the recordings. I don’t know what’s changed in the app, and yes record to SD card is checked in the app.
I guess they really want you to pay that subscription which I’m not. The reason I bought this camera was to be able to record to the SD card without a subscription.
